newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: DBS Land sets up holding company.
newsitem.headline: DBS Land sets up holding company.

text.p: DBS Land said on Wednesday it had incorporated wholly-owned subsidiary Stamford Holdings Pte Ltd to handle its service apartment business.
The subsidiary has an authorised and paid-up capital of S$1 million comprising one million shares valued at S$1 each, a company statement said.

Stamford Holdings has subsribed for one million shares worth S$1 each in the capital of Stamford Hospitality Management Pte Ltd, which will provide pre-opening and management services for its apartment business.

Stamford Holdings has also subscribed for 500,000 shares worth S$1 each in Stamford Residences Pte Ltd, which will serve as the primary property investment holding outfit for service apartments and related property investments of DBS Land.
